This module assesses whether accounting data/treatment appears inconsistent with the applicable accounting framework, using standards-informed analytical checks. It never states that something is non-compliant or that a violation is confirmed — findings are always labeled Potential Accounting Exception, Review Required, Potential Inconsistency, or Insufficient Data, for a professional to review and confirm. It runs only against data you have already validated and confirmed on the Mapping and Data Quality screens — nothing unvalidated is read.
